name: page-header
title: Page header
description: Breadcrumb, serif page title, a one-line lead and actions on the right. Every page starts with one.
whenToUse: Top of every page, first child of tx-main. Put the page's main actions (or a stepper) in tx-page-header__actions. Use tx-kicker for a small gold label above a title.

variants.description: Trail of links; the last item is the current page.
Gold rule and tracked uppercase label above a title.
Buttons or a stepper, aligned to the bottom right; wraps below on narrow screens.

a11y: One <h1> per page, here. The breadcrumb is a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with aria-current="page" on the last item.
